verdict.rationale: Anytype documents native iOS and Android apps, and mobile-to-desktop sync, including a local-only mode that syncs desktop and mobile. Community users say the iOS app is well-crafted and that the Apple and Android apps work well. Nothing in the pack shows the mobile apps carry the full knowledge base with capture, search, linking and graph at desktop parity, and comm-2 describes only basic note use. Missing for 10: documented mobile feature parity for capture, search and linking; mobile-specific capture flows (share sheet, quick add); independent hands-on reports of power-user mobile workflows.
